description:
This project is the work of Douglas B. Pierce, Side of Beef Productions. First imagined in 2007, the project remains
    a command line tool for generating thematic names and first career characters for Warhammer Fantasty Roleplay, 
    Second Edition, released in 2005 by Black Industries, an imprint of BL Publishing.
      
    All Warhammer and Warhammer related material is ®, ™ and/or © 2000-2026 Games Workshop, Ltd., variably registered in
    the UK and other countries around the world. All Rights Reserved.
     
    This tool includes Warhammer material for completely unofficial use by players and fans and in no way endorsed by
    Games Workshop, Ltd.
